subject: FWD: You're invited: Trump in Gastonia, Sept 16

body:
Peter,Tomorrow night, President Trump comes to Gastonia -- **and this is our last chance to pack the room.** Space is almost gone. [**If you haven't registered yet, now's the time.**](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-firtuuk-hkhielhuy-r/) [REGISTER TO ATTEND](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-firtuuk-hkhielhuy-y/) North Carolina shows up when it counts. Let's prove it tomorrow night.I'll see you there.--Tim
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Tim Moore
Date: Sat, Sep 12, 2026, at 10:00 AM
Subject: You're invited: Trump in Gastonia, Sept 16
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Peter,President Trump is coming to Gastonia -- and I need you standing with us when he gets here.Next Wednesday, September 16th, President Trump will deliver remarks in Gastonia, North Carolina. **House and Senate Republicans are fighting alongside President Trump every day to cut taxes, secure the border, and put American families first -- and this is our chance to hear directly from him.****WHAT:** President Donald J. Trump -- Remarks in Gastonia, NC
**WHEN:** Wednesday, September 16, 2026 -- 7:00 PM ET
**WHERE:** Gastonia Municipal Airport, 1126 Gaston Day School Rd, Gastonia, NC 28056North Carolina has always shown up when it counts. This is our moment to do it again -- **to stand behind the agenda that's putting America First.** [REGISTER TO ATTEND](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-firtuuk-hkhielhuy-j/) Space is going to fill up fast. This is our chance to show the President -- and the whole country -- exactly what North Carolina is made of.I'll see you there. Congressman Tim Moore
